The 9-Way Combo LIVE trigger (trig_01AZXmLrvMg4B1Gka5kreqcR) and Day-Trading LIVE trigger (trig_01GY1mk2Eo68gMX5YdS34zGW) were disabled the same day. All 5 of 9-Way Combo's real positions (AMD/MU/WDC/SNDK/TSM) were liquidated to free their capital (realized ~-$181.68); Day-Trading LIVE held no positions. Margin-Style Live now sizes against the full $5,000. Original equal 3-way split notes (2026-07-22) superseded by this entry.

UPDATED 2026-08-21: per explicit user request, a real $5,000 deposit into the Agentic-2 account (912291820) is added to Margin-Style Live's allocation, 5,000.00 -> 10,000.00. Confirmed via get_portfolio: real account cash jumped to $8,447.25 (from ~$2,497 before this run), consistent with a genuine new deposit landing, not just today's trading activity. No other system's allocation changes (still $0, both paused). This does not itself change any strategy parameter (TRANCHE_SCHEDULE, TRADE_CAP_SCHEDULE, MAX_HOLD_DAYS, kill-switch threshold, etc.) - all per-trade and per-symbol caps are already expressed as a % of current total_equity, so they scale automatically with the larger capital base without needing a fresh backtest at this size specifically; the underlying % parameters remain the ones validated at $5k/$10k/$15k/$20k during the 2026-08-14 MAX_TRADE_NOTIONAL_PCT walk-forward.

RETIRED (for margin_style) 2026-08-21, same day: the fixed allocation ceiling for margin_style is no longer used for sizing. This file's split was built for the 2026-07-22..07-24 period when three live systems shared one real account and each needed a reserved slice to avoid overspending capital the others were counting on - both other systems have been disabled since 07-24 (paper-only), leaving Margin-Style Live as the sole live trader, so there is no longer a second consumer of the account's capital to protect a slice against. The trigger now sizes directly off get_portfolio's real "cash" field each run instead of computing allocation-used-pending. Backtested against a frozen ceiling on every standard window (honest cash-ledger methodology, $10,000 start): 6-month +99.4%->+155.7%, Continuous +99.2%->+154.4%, walk-forward TRAIN +39.4%->+45.6%, walk-forward TEST +59.8%->+74.7% - the fixed ceiling was a real, undetected drag: as open positions' mark-to-market grows, allocation-used shrinks toward zero even while genuinely free settled cash sits unused, since the formula can't tell the difference between capital that's unavailable and capital that's just sitting in a currently-profitable position. A periodic ceiling-ratchet alternative (raise the number to match real value ~monthly) was tested first and found to lag behind this simpler direct approach on every window (ratchet always has up to ~21 trading days of catch-up lag; direct sizing has none). The margin_style figure above (10,000.00) is now vestigial - kept for historical reference and in case 9-Way Combo or Day-Trading LIVE are ever reactivated alongside Margin-Style Live, at which point some capital-sharing logic would need to return before this fixed-slice model (or a replacement) becomes relevant again. swing and daytrade entries are unaffected (still $0, both paused, no live consumer).
